name: interviewly
description: Interview prep that reads your CV and your real code: mock interviews with real follow-ups, project study guides, walkthrough practice, an honest CV check and daily drills. Vibe coded it? Larp it till you make it: learn the code until you can explain every line.

interface.shortDescription: You built it. Now explain it.
interface.longDescription: Give Interviewly a job description and your CV. It reads your real project code, predicts the questions you'll get with answers from your own work, runs mock interviews with real follow-ups, and teaches you the parts of your projects you can't explain yet, including code you built with AI.
defaultPrompt: Help me prepare for this job: <paste the job description>
Quiz me on my project like a real interviewer
